title: Cohasset Sailing Club Founders' Hall

services.name: Jr. Lessons
services.desc: The CSC Junior Program is designed to introduce young sailors to the fundamentals of sailing and encourage a lifelong love for knowledge of and confidence in the wind and sea. Instructors - high schoolers and college students from Cohasset - teach the essential skills of rigging, safety, boat handling, and sail trim

services.name: Open Sail
services.desc: The CSC’s fleet of boats is available for members to take out on the water on their own or with friends or family. Instructors and staff are on hand to help rig the boat before heading out on the water and to assist in unrigging once you’re done. The trained staff is also ready to assist you with a Boston Whaler should the wind or tide take unexpected turns. All members must complete the helmsman test prior to taking a boat out. Life jacket and closed toe shoes required. Our Marshall Sandpiper will also be available for Free Sailing beginning Saturday, July 25. blurb: We are a non-profit community sailing club that has served as a rite of passage for Cohasset youth since 1960. Our primary mission is to teach juniors how to sail while fostering independence, confidence, and an appreciation for the wind and ocean.
